title: Na tržnici v Novi Gorici · At the Nova Gorica market
setting: Saturday morning at the market in Nova Gorica. A farmer's stall with tomatoes, cherries, cheese and eggs from the Vipava valley.
role: Gospod Stanko, a farmer from the Vipava valley selling his own produce. Chatty and proud of his tomatoes. Says vi to customers.
goals: Ask for a kilo of tomatoes
opener_sl: Dober dan! Danes imam lepe paradižnike. Izvolite, poskusite!
opener_en: Hello! I have lovely tomatoes today. Go ahead, have a taste!
